name: Lanternwick Glowworms
summary: A carpet of glowing cave larvae on the ceiling that drops sticky threads to haul prey up into the light.
description: From below, a lanternwick colony looks like a field of cold stars, and more than one lost traveler has walked toward it thinking it was the sky. Each larva lets down a beaded thread of glue; together they make a curtain that catches moths, bats, and now and then a person. Miners prize the dried threads as lamp wicks that never quite go out.

traits.name: Ceiling Dwellers
traits.text: The swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

traits.name: Glow
traits.text: The swarm sheds {ref:glossary/dim-light} in a 20-foot radius.

traits.name: Swarm
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny larva. The swarm can't regain {ref:glossary/hit-points} or gain {ref:glossary/temporary-hit-points}.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The swarm uses Snaring Threads and makes one Bites attack.

actions.name: Bites
actions.onHit: The attack deals half damage if the swarm is {ref:glossary/bloodied}.

actions.name: Snaring Threads

save.targets: one creature within 15 feet of the swarm

actions.onFailure: The target is pulled up to 10 feet straight toward the swarm and has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition until the end of the swarm's next turn.
